data.name: Castle Reborn
data.detailed_description:
The castle never truly sleeps.

Whenever the black moon rises, long-dead creatures awaken and the castle reshapes its halls, courtyards, and crypts. As a hunter entering forbidden ground, you must survive swarms of undead in a 45-degree isometric voxel world, claim the powers hidden within, and uncover the source of the endless night.

Every run brings new routes, enemies, and upgrade choices. Discover weapons, strengthen your abilities, and collect relics that transform how you fight. Build around close-range assaults, ranged weapons, area attacks, or survival—and find combinations that turn separate powers into a devastating whole.

Death ends the run, not the hunt. Learn the enemies, choose a different path, rebuild your arsenal, and return to a castle that is never quite the same.

Key Features

AN EVER-CHANGING CURSED CASTLE

Routes, room layouts, enemies, and rewards shift between runs. Cross stone corridors, haunted crypts, and cursed halls while deciding where to venture next.

BUILD YOUR WAY TO HUNT

Collect weapons, relics, and upgrades that gradually shape each run. Create clear, satisfying builds around melee combat, ranged attacks, area damage, or survival.

FACE THE HORDES OF NIGHT

Move, evade, and find space as undead, demons, and twisted creatures close in from every direction. Break through the horde and challenge the monsters waiting deeper inside.

A VOXEL GOTHIC WORLD

Classic gothic architecture, monsters, and hunters are rebuilt in a bold, blocky 3D voxel style. The 45-degree isometric view keeps enemies, attack ranges, and the battlefield easy to read.

DIE. RETURN. GO DEEPER.

Every defeat teaches you more about the castle. Change your choices, discover new combinations, and push farther on your next return.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 3 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti 2GB or AMD Radeon RX 460 2GB
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
